name: Experience Genome
purpose: Study successful game experiences, extract reusable design principles, and produce original games from those principles.
rules: analyze mechanics loops pacing controls progression encounter structure retention social dynamics and accessibility
record abstract patterns and measurable hypotheses rather than copying expressive content
never reproduce protected characters story dialogue maps art music branding or distinctive audiovisual identity
combine patterns from multiple sources with original mechanics worldbuilding and playtest evidence
promote patterns only after internal prototypes and player evidence
